listing.name: MoreVanillaBounties
listing.summary: Adds More Vanilla bounties (3x more min and max) and More Vanilla bounties (Remnant, Derelict, Pather, and Mercenary bounties)
listing.aiSummary: Increases vanilla bounty limits and adds new bounty types.

description: Triples the minimum and maximum values for vanilla bounties. Adds Remnant, Derelict, Pather, and Mercenary bounties. Includes functional scaling and a 30-day duration.
